_README: Appearance FACTS for sitters whose source photo is black and white (or colour-cast),
so the model does not invent hair, eye or skin colour. Each line describes the sitter
AT THE DATE OF THE SOURCE PHOTO. 'basis' says how each fact was established:
'seen' = read off dated colour photos found by image search (Bing Images, Commons), not reused;
'text' = a written first-hand description; 'tone' = inferred from the grey tone of the

karajan.facts: He is 55 years old, with thick silver-grey hair swept back from a high forehead, blue eyes and fair skin with visible lines.

basis.hair: seen: colour photos of the 1960s show grey-white hair
basis.eyes: text: 'penetrating blue eyes' (C Major Entertainment essay)

_VARIANTS: A key 'slug.variant' trials ANOTHER source photo for a sitter without touching
sources.json (which still drives the shipped photo medallions). Its 'source'
overrides file/crop/year; renders are named after the full key. Promote a
variant into sources.json only once it is chosen.
